subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 14=7 Addiction means strong (a) _____ (attract) for any (b) _____ (harm) thing. Drug (c) _____ (addict) means taking heroin, opium, marijuana, phensydil etc. Some of these are (d) _____ (take) for (e) _____ (intoxicate) and (f) _____ (stimulate) effect. The (g) _____ (take) of these drugs (h) _____ (frequent) leads a man to (i) _____ (die). Drug (j) _____ (addict) is not only a (k) _____ (nation) but also a (l) _____ (globe) problem. We should prevent our young (m) _____ (generate) from this (n) _____ (harm) bad habit.
guide_solution: (a) attraction (b) harmful (c) addiction (d) taken (e) intoxication (f) stimulation (g) taking (h) frequently (i) death (j) addiction (k) national (l) global (m) generation (n) harmful
